## Overview

Five courses delivered over 12 weeks (Aug 4 – Oct 24, 2025). Sessions are
scheduled **Monday–Wednesday** to keep Thursday and Friday free.

- **Monday & Tuesday**: Content delivery (📘)
- **Wednesday**: Office hours and follow-ups only (💬)

Each standard course runs over **4 weeks**:

- Weeks 1–2: Content delivery (6h across Mon–Tue)
- Weeks 3–4: Follow-up sessions on Wed (overlap with next course start)

**targets/geotargets** is a double course (12h content) and runs over **4 weeks**
of teaching + follow-ups.

### Session legend

- 📘 = Content session (1h)
- 💬 = Office hour / follow-up (1h)

---

## Course 5: Introduction to targets & geotargets (Weeks 9–12)

*This is a double-length course (12h content + 3h office hours). Some days
have 2h of content to fit the material into the Mon–Tue slots.*

### Week 9 — Sep 29

|-----|-------|---------|

| Tue | 1h | 📘 Debugging Functions: browser(), debug(), debugonce(), options(recover) |
